issue_title: pdm doesn't work well when install git repository
issue_body:
### Describe the bug

pdm doesn't work well when install git repository. related issue: #3107 

### To reproduce

```
pdm init
pdm add ibflex@git+https://github.com/csingley/ibflex.git@af6a0c6 -v
```


### Expected Behavior

pdm should success install the git repository

### Environment Information

```
$ pdm info && pdm info --env
PDM version:
  2.23.0
Python Interpreter:
  /tmp/tmp/.venv/bin/python (3.10)
Project Root:
  /tmp/tmp
Local Packages:
  
{
  "implementation_name": "cpython",
  "implementation_version": "3.10.7",
  "os_name": "posix",
  "platform_machine": "x86_64",
  "platform_release": "6.13.6",
  "platform_system": "Linux",
  "platform_version": "#1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC 1",
  "python_full_version": "3.10.7",
  "platform_python_implementation": "CPython",
  "python_version": "3.10",
  "sys_platform": "linux"
}
```
